title: Delhi High Court denies bail to Mansoor Ashgar Peerbhoy in 2008 Delhi serial blasts case
description: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday denied bail to the alleged Indian Mujahideen operative Mansoor Asghar Peerbhoy in the 2008 Delhi serial blasts case. A Division Bench of Justices Prathiba M Singh and Madhu Jain said that Peerbhoy is stated to be the head of the media cell of the Indian Mujahideen and, according to prosecutors, was centrally involved in the transmission of an email titled 'Message of Death' just minutes before the blast, claiming responsibility for the attack.
